nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Product use phase_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the influence of the duration of use on consumer adoption of access-based product-service systems according to Tun net al. (2021)?
nodes.answer: According to Tun net al. (2021), the duration of use has an influence on consumer adoption of access-based product-service systems.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Product use phase_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can calculating the cost per use of a new garment influence consumer behaviour?
nodes.answer: Calculating the cost per use of a new garment could encourage consumers to buy less, as they become more aware of the value they are getting out of each purchase.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Product use phase_qna_004
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: How does the post-consumption phase of the resource life cycle aim to benefit consumers?
nodes.answer: The post-consumption phase aims to provide consumers with a better understanding of what they can do with their clothing after use, promoting sustainable disposal and reuse options.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Product use phase_qna_005
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: Why is it important to analyse plastics consumer profiles based on their behaviour across multiple countries?
nodes.answer: Analysing plastics consumer profiles across multiple countries is crucial to understand target groups and effectively trigger desired behaviour. It helps in tailoring strategies to specific consumer segments and enhancing the effectiveness of sustainable plastics initiatives on a larger scale.
